rules.why: Install time may be stated as 8 or 10 minutes; both are fine (Greg 2026-10-18: 'Either 8 min or 10 min is FINE'). Other numbers are not approved.
The offer is Lifetime Hardware Replacement: if it breaks, we send a new one. Never 'warranty'. Matches warranty words only, so ordinary 'warrants it' passes (2026-10-19).

The $349 is a one-time setup investment per sensor (Greg 2026-10-27, D-20261027-TP-SETUP-349), so a $349 must be tied to a sensor or to setup in the same sentence. Replaces 349-is-hardware, which tied it to hardware.

The client buys nothing; the gear is rented and the $349 pays for cellular setup, sensor selection, shipping and handling, and a one-on-one engineer build-out (Greg 2026-10-27: "They don't 'buy' anything. It's simply a sensor set up investment"). Never call the $349 hardware, a device price or a purchase. Replaces 349-not-setup, which refused the setup wording this ruling requires.
A TinyPumper ad never offers itself as an alternative to TinyPumper.
A GreaseBook ad never offers itself as an alternative to GreaseBook.
200% money-back is GreaseBook only; TinyPumper is a straight 60-day money-back.
The 6% stat is GreaseBook only.
The client self-installs TinyPumper. Never 'we install it'.
Cellular is included.

GreaseBook publishes the pricing model, never a number. On pages a price is a dollar figure per month, well, user or year; articles may still cite industry costs such as a $200k cloud bill (2026-10-19).
Speed lever: installs in 8 or 10 minutes (Greg 2026-10-18: "Either 8 min or 10 min is FINE").
Likelihood lever: 60-day money-back.
Coverage lever: works in dead zones (satellite, 100% continental US coverage).
Lifetime Hardware Replacement lever.
Likelihood lever: 200% money-back.
Speed lever: 8-minute pumper learning curve.
Effort lever: our petroleum engineers do the setup.
Proof lever: 600+ producers, 98% success rate.
GreaseBook prepares state production reports; the operator submits them (Greg 2026-10-17: "prepare for operator to submit"). Never files, auto-files or files themselves.

rules.pattern: Mississippi, Alabama|\bTX, MS, AL\b|\bMS, AL, WY\b
rules.why: State reports cover any producing state; a fixed list reads as exclusion (Greg 2026-07-11).
Prospect copy says satellite gives 100% continental US coverage and never mentions cellular (Greg 2026-10-15).
Cellular and satellite do not switch on their own: each gateway uses one connection or the other (Greg 2026-10-15). A false fact on every ad and page, competitor ads included.
Radar is the only TinyPumper tank sensor (Greg 2026-10-17).
